items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: FAQ questions and answers. Native details and summary, ringed like cards.

items.name: announcement-dot-strip
items.title: AnnouncementDotStrip
items.description: The animated dot strip behind the announcement bar.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A one or two word status next to a title ("Recommended", "Beta").

items.name: blog-cover
items.title: BlogCoverArt
items.description: Animated dot cover art for a post card. Six motifs, on paper (white) or blue.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Every action. Pill, 1px border, 16px label, sentence case.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The ringed card. White card inside a blue 10 ring, or a blue card inside a blue 80 ring.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary choice with a visible label. Also the check items under the hero demo (disabled, checked).

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Small tags under a card title ("Fresh sources for RAG") and "Also in the API" links.

items.name: code-window
items.title: CodeWindow
items.description: SDK samples and the agent setup prompt. Window with three dots (first solid), title or tabs, copy.

items.name: credits-dot-number
items.title: CreditsDotNumber
items.description: A figure drawn in dots that morphs into Doto, such as 1,000 free credits or a step number.

items.name: customer-logo-dots
items.title: CustomerLogoDots
items.description: A customer logo sampled into the dot grid, white on a blue story card.

items.name: cx
items.title: Cx
items.description: Join and merge class names. A class passed in replaces the default it conflicts with. Every registry component uses it.

items.name: dot-engine
items.title: resolveColor
items.description: The shared dot animation engine: eased hollow and solid dots, liquid fusion, glyph morphs, story timing. Used by every animated dot item.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: DotGrid
items.description: Static dot drawings and simple patterns. For the animated pictures from context.dev, use dot-story.

items.name: dot-story
items.title: DotScene
items.description: The animated dot pictures from context.dev. Each scene is a looping story drawn in the brand dot grid.

items.name: footer-watermark
items.title: FooterWatermark
items.description: The giant dotted context.dev wordmark at the bottom of the footer, with its cursor.

items.name: hero-dot-field
items.title: HeroDotField
items.description: The hero dot field: a live pattern with the logo cut from it, and optional stat morphs.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text fields. Always labelled.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The Context.dev logo. Logomark, horizontal or vertical combination mark, in the approved colorways.

items.name: ring-backdrop
items.title: RingBackdrop
items.description: A faint field of hollow rings behind art or a card, clipped to whole rings.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: The outer shell of every block. Surface, ruled center column, vertical rhythm, data-ds-block.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: SectionHeading
items.description: The heading of every section. Headline with the key phrase in blue, one line of muted sub, optional action on the right.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choosing one of a short list (plan, SDK language). Native select for accessibility.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One large, provable figure in Doto with a one-line label ("94%" of pages returned as clean content).

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data that people compare across rows: credit costs, plan limits, benchmark numbers. Tables, not cards, for data.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switching between 2 to 6 parallel views of one thing (benchmark metrics, FAQ topics, SDK languages).

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text, such as the FAQ "Ask anything" box or a contact message.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for an icon-only control or an abbreviation. Hover and focus.

items.name: trust-mark
items.title: TrustMark
items.description: Animated dot marks for the trust cards: SOC 2, zero data retention, uptime.

items.name: agent-onboarding
items.title: AgentOnboarding
items.description: The two ways to start, side by side. Do it yourself (white card), or let your agent do it (blue card, recommended).

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: AnnouncementBar
items.description: One line above the nav announcing one new API or feature, with a link.

items.name: benchmark
items.title: Benchmark
items.description: The proof that Context.dev is better and cheaper. Tabs of metrics, each a dot bar chart against named competitors.

items.name: blog-grid
items.title: BlogGrid
items.description: The latest six posts on a black band, cards alternating white and blue, each with animated dot cover art.

items.name: code-showcase
items.title: CodeShowcase
items.description: Show the real SDK call for each job, one tab per job, description left and code right.

items.name: credit-costs
items.title: CreditCosts
items.description: What each API costs in credits, grouped by product area, as tables.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CtaBand
items.description: The closing section of every page. One headline, one line of sub, the free offer and one outline action.

items.name: faq
items.title: Faq
items.description: Questions that remove doubt before sign-up. Heading and one action on the left, questions on the right.

items.name: feature-trio
items.title: FeatureTrio
items.description: Three things you control with one API, side by side, each with an animated dot scene.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: The site footer on black. Logo, tagline, four link columns, compliance, status, legal links, dotted watermark.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Top of a marketing page. One message, one filled primary action, one outline secondary.

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: LogoWall
items.description: Proof right under the hero. Six or twelve customer names, one outline link to their stories.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: The top navigation on every marketing page. Logo, five links, "Book demo", "Start for free".

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: PricingTable
items.description: The plan comparison on the pricing page. One column per plan, price, credits, limits, one action each.

items.name: product-grid
items.title: ProductGrid
items.description: The four core APIs as a 2x2 grid of ringed cards, plus a row of links to the rest of the API.

items.name: related-products
items.title: RelatedProducts
items.description: Two neighbouring APIs at the end of a product page, as linked cards.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Three numbered steps from sign-up to a working feature, with the heading and one action on the left.

items.name: story-rail
items.title: StoryRail
items.description: Customer stories as a horizontal row of blue cards the visitor scrolls themselves.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Three short customer quotes with name, role and a link to the case study.

items.name: trust-grid
items.title: TrustGrid
items.description: Security and reliability for the buyer who spends 100k. Three cards and a link to the trust center.

items.name: use-case-grid
items.title: UseCaseGrid
items.description: What teams build with the API. Two or six ringed cards in a two-column grid, each with a dot drawing.

items.name: landing
items.title: LandingTemplate
items.description: The homepage and campaign landing pages. One message, one primary action, the agent path next to it.

items.name: pricing
items.title: PricingTemplate
items.description: The pricing page. Plans, credit costs as a table, the FAQ that removes doubt, one close.

items.name: product
items.title: ProductTemplate
items.description: A page for one API (Search, Scrape, Research, Monitors, Map, Crawl, Batches, Brand). What it returns, the code, how to start.
